problem:
What is the linear transformation $T$ whose standard matrix is $T=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 5 \\ 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 7 & 1\end{aligned}]?$

| $T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶\,\,$ |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | {{field-2}} |  |  |
|  | {{field-3}} |  |  |
worked_solution:
Consider a general vector $\,[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}].$ Multiplying by the matrix $T,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 5 \\ 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 7 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5z \\ 2x \\ 7y+z\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $\,T\,$ is given by

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}5z \\ 2x \\ 7y+z\end{aligned}].
$$
